The '''Pamorjal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It consisted of nine [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in orbit around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Garbat]]. The planet [[Pamorjal]] was the fourth planet in orbit and was the only habitable one of the nine.
